title: gagea pratensis subsp. nova
intro: Gagea pratensis subsp. nova, commonly known as the Wood Lily, is a perennial plant species belonging to the lily family (Liliaceae). The Wood Lily has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including inflammation and respiratory problems, due to its numerous health benefits. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, which help to soothe and calm irritated tissues and promote the removal of mucus from the airways. The bioactive constituents of the Wood Lily include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
